Bidder has to quote total lump sum contract value including GST as per scope of work and quantity as per clause 2 & 3 of STM/WC/MTAS/2627/01. i. In case GST rate applicable to any bidder is different (i.e. from GST@18%), then docu mentary evidence along with 8-digit SAC/HSN code in support of quoted applicable rate to be provided by the bidder. Non-submission of documentary evidence for quoted rate of GST, the bid is liable to be rejected at any stage of tender even after price bid openin g. Note: Conditions at clause a(i) and a(ii) above shall be applicabl e for ITC based evaluation on GeM only. MP government minimum wages for the skilled, semi-skilled and Unskilled is to be consi dered as per table given below. Type of Worker MP government minimum wages effecti ve from 01.10.2026 Skilled Rs. 588.00 Semi-Skilled Rs. 522.00 Un Skilled Rs. 484.00 The above rates revised by BHEL HR (CLC) in every month of April and October in a year . Contractor shall ensure the payment of statutory minimum wages recommended by B HEL and PF, ESI, Contribution to Labour Welfare Board and bonus as per statutory requir ements” as per Minimum wage circular issued by BHEL HR(CLC)”. c. Before tendering, the tenderer is advised to inspect the site of work and the environme nt and be acquainted with the actual working and other prevalent conditions, facilities av ailable etc. No claim will be entertained later on grounds of lack of knowledge. Bidder ar e also advised to read thoroughly all the clauses of the tenders and understand the same before tender is submitted. d. Prior to quoting his rates, the tenderer may visit the factory area / site to get acquainte d in person with the existing installations/establishments/facilities and to ascertain for hi mself the quantum and nature of work involved. Offer should be submitted keeping in m ind all the factors and related incidental expenditure. No claim will be entertained later o n any ground. BHEL will not pay any extra charges after acceptance of the contract even if it is found later that the Bidder has misjudged the nature and scope of work. e. In case of any query/doubt on the tender specifications, bidder shall contact the concer ned authority for clarification before tender submission. No condition/deviation w.r.t. ter ms & conditions of the tender are acceptable. f. Detailed information regarding bidding document if required can be obtained from Sh. Arpit Sahu, Mgr (STM), (Phone 0755-2505969, Mob: 7587139714, email: arpitsahu@bhel .in) between 10 AM to 4 PM on all working days. g. Each page of the offer shall be duly signed by an authorized person of agency, with all formalities. h. Bid lower than Rs 38,10,802/- (inclusive of GST) shall be rejected. . 3.
